findings.title: Title Text Contrast
findings.problem: The title text 'SMDUEL' has low contrast against the background, making it hard to read.
findings.why: This can lead to difficulty in quickly identifying the game, especially in a fast-paced environment.
findings.fix: Add a thin dark outline or shadow to the title text to enhance its visibility against the background.

findings.title: Radar Indicator Clarity
findings.where: Arena and Road Screens, bottom left corner
findings.problem: The radar displays a simple circle with a single triangular indicator, which lacks clarity on what is being represented.
findings.why: Players need clear information about nearby entities, and this current design may confuse users about its functionality.
findings.fix: Enhance the radar with markers for visible opponents, and use color coding (e.g. green for friendlies, red for enemies) for better differentiation.

findings.title: Vehicle Constructor Layout Issues
findings.problem: The list of components (Armor, Weapon slots, etc.) is cluttered, with insufficient spacing and inconsistent font sizes.
findings.why: This can overwhelm players and hinder usability, making it difficult to comprehend their options when building a vehicle.
findings.fix: Increase the spacing between list items and standardize font sizes for better readability and organization.

findings.title: Arena Background Pattern
findings.problem: The arena background consists of a busy pixelated texture that distracts from the gameplay elements.
findings.why: Distraction can lead to confusion when players need to focus on their vehicle and any opponents.
findings.fix: Replace the background with a simpler, more muted texture that enhances gameplay focus without losing the arena context.

findings.title: Mission Progress Bar Visibility
findings.problem: The mission progress bar is thin and lacks visual distinction from the background.
findings.why: This can lead to missed information about distance and mission goals, especially during high-speed maneuvers.
findings.fix: Thicken the progress bar and use a contrasting color, with distinct markers at important milestones for clearer tracking.
